categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 本批论文集中在具身智能与世界模型，涵盖机器人集群记忆、动作-视频生成、空间理解基准以及 Agent 在材料科研中的应用。

articles.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
articles.zh: 关节、相机、开拍！为任意 Rig 配置联合生成3D动作与视频
articles.summary: 如果你在做3D动画或机器人仿真，需要动作和镜头一起出，这篇讲的是任意 rig 下动作与视频同步生成的路线
articles.author: Noam Rotstein, Yoad Tewel 等
articles.body: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.
articles.bodyZh: 视频生成模型（video generation models）现在能做出特别逼真的动作了。但问题来了：除了看像素，我们还不清楚怎么把这些动作用起来，比如让某个具体的3D资产（3D asset）动起来，再把这套动画放回它的3D场景里重播。打个比方，视频模型能展示一只猴子跳过横杆，但它没法把这次跳跃变成可重播的3D动作，再放回3D场景里。我们这里提出一个模型，能针对任意给定的角色绑定（rig），直接同时生成视频和3D动作，还能给出一个相机（camera），把这个动作对齐到场景里。之前的视频-动作模型（video-motion models）要么只处理人的骨架（skeleton），而且常常要多加几十亿参数；要么从生成的2D姿态图（2D pose maps）里三角化出3D动作。我们不一样：把3D动作放在一个单独的模型里，让它支持任意骨架，再通过少量交叉注意力层（cross-attention layers）接到一个预训练视频模型（pretrained video model）上。这样拆开的好处是，动作模型可以先只靠动作数据学会骨架怎么动，而这类数据比成对的视频更容易拿到、也更容易扩充。另外，我们的模型会学着在视频帧里定位每个关节（joint），这样我们就能反推出相机，并把3D动作放进场景。为了跨很多骨架训练，我们用生成式视频编辑器（generative video editor）把带动画的3D资产放进适合它们动作的场景里，并把这些编辑整理好，让已知的动作仍然有效。再加上人类和机器人的视频，我们总共得到将近20万对训练数据。评估显示，我们的模型能比“先做视频”的流程更忠实地根据文本给各种绑定做动画，而且它的动作会响应周围场景。它还能把视频变成绑定动作、把绑定动作变成视频，并支持对3D动作做基于关键帧的控制（keyframe-based control）。视频和更多结果都在项目页：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/。

articles.title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
articles.zh: GBClaw：面向原子级晶界研究与机理发现的 Agent 框架
articles.summary: 如果你做材料计算，被晶界建模和机理筛查的人力成本拖住，这套 Agent 框架想把这整条流程自动化
articles.author: Yazhuo Liu, Kunqing Ding 等
articles.body: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.
articles.bodyZh: 智能体式人工智能（agentic AI）系统在材料发现和设计里自动跑复杂流程，潜力非常大；但要把它们扩展到需要大量领域知识的机理研究上，仍然很棘手。我们提出了 GBClaw——一个用来研究一般晶界（general grain boundaries, GBs）结构和变形行为的智能体式AI框架。现实多晶材料里的界面绝大多数都是这类一般晶界，可它们偏偏研究得不够，因为结构太复杂、界面失配（interfacial mismatch）又让实验和建模都很难做。GBClaw 把大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）整合进一套模块化架构（modular architecture），里面有调度器（orchestrator）、专门智能体（specialized agents）、领域专用工具（domain-specific tools）、仿真接口（simulation interfaces）和分层记忆（hierarchical memory）。靠着动态重规划（dynamic replanning）和迭代式流程优化（iterative workflow refinement），这套框架能把系统化仿真和有针对性的机理分析有效串起来。把它用到镍中的14个一般非对称倾转晶界（general asymmetric tilt GBs）上时，GBClaw 刻画了界面缺陷结构（interfacial defect structures），并发现这些不匹配边界（incommensurate boundaries）上出现了多种变形模式（deformation modes）。比较有、无次级晶界错配位错（secondary GB misfit dislocations）时的晶界滑移（boundary sliding），会发现剪切强度（shear strength）差别很大，这也说明缺陷层级（defect hierarchies）对滑移阻力（sliding resistance）起着关键作用。进一步，研究人员引导的后续计算把异常高的剪切阻力追踪到了亚稳晶界结构（metastable boundary structures）上。这项工作说明，把智能体式AI和领域专业知识结合起来，可以架起高通量计算筛选（high-throughput computational screening）和对复杂材料界面深入物理理解之间的桥梁。

articles.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
articles.zh: UniWALM：面向具身机器人控制的统一世界-动作-语言模型
articles.summary: 如果你在琢磨具身智能怎么把世界模型、动作和语言捏进一个模型，这篇给了一个统一建模的尝试
articles.author: Rahul Sajnani, Diego Romeres 等
articles.body: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
articles.bodyZh: 我们受到人类能力的启发：人能把语言、感知和行动经验串起来。基于这个想法，我们提出了 UniWALM，一个统一的世界-动作-语言模型（world-action-language model），它在同一个共享表征（shared representation）里同时学习视频、动作和语言，而且每种模态既当条件信号，也当监督目标。我们想问：联合生成语言，能不能让这个共享表征更丰富，从而提升操作能力、支持依赖记忆的行为？跟以前把推理模型或视觉-语言模型挂在视频-动作骨干网络上、分阶段跑的方法不同，UniWALM 把三种模态统一进一个 Transformer 混合骨干网络（mixture-of-transformers backbone）里，每个模态的扩散头（diffusion heads）同步联合去噪，在生成动作的同一轮里解码子任务和文本记忆，不需要单独的规划阶段；生成出来的语言下一步再被喂回去用，形成一个“语言当记忆”的闭环，不靠外部规划器，也不靠记忆库。为了让动作流在这么丰富的目标下仍然可靠，我们还引入了带校正的流匹配（Flow Matching with Correction，FMC）训练目标，教模型从被扰动的动作轨迹里恢复，而且推理时不增加额外开销。UniWALM 在同一骨干网络的基线（比如 FastWAM）上稳定更强：在组合式抓放任务（MolmoSpaces）上更好，在 RMBench 里依赖记忆的子集上也更好；它没有任何预训练语言模型或推理模型，就达到 34.5%，而且只用一张锚帧（anchor frame）就超过了 Mem-0 配备关键帧的方案（28.5%）。在真实世界的找物任务（Find-the-Item）上，生成文本记忆把成功率从 11.1% 提到 61.1%，而最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）还停在瞎猜水平或以下（≤33.3%）。

articles.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
articles.zh: Industrial ReMEmbR：将时空记忆扩展到机器人集群
articles.summary: 如果你以为机器人记忆只是单机的事，这篇提醒你多机共享时空记忆的规模化才是工业落地的真瓶颈
articles.author: Jad Yammine, Malek Wahidi 等
articles.body: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.
articles.bodyZh: 仓库里的机器人编队会一直观察运行状况，但要把这些观察保存成能反复使用的语义记忆（semantic memory），计算、通信和存储成本都很高。比如想解释为什么过道老是堵，可能得翻好几台机器人、好几个班次的视频来回看。我们提出了 IndustrialRemembr，这是一个共享的时空记忆系统，把 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展到了机器人集群，并且只在需要时才生成场景描述，从而减少服务器端的计算量。每台机器人上，NVIDIA Jetson 会用 Cosmos-Embed1 把视频片段编码成检索嵌入向量（retrieval embeddings），用 Cosmos3-Edge 编码成视觉词元（vision tokens），用 Wan2.2 VAE（变分自编码器）编码成重建潜变量（reconstruction latents），全程不用上传原始摄像头画面。这些编码模型还会被重复利用，在图像区块里检测出人，再把人的区域抹掉，从而支持个人身份信息（PII）抽象化，满足《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）合规部署的要求。我们把 Cosmos3-Edge 从视觉和语言的分界处拆开：视觉编码器放在机器人上，语言解码器放在本地服务器（on-premises server）上。Nemotron 智能体（agent）会按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并用缓存的视觉词元去查询解码器。这种设计在写入阶段不用生成描述文字（caption generation），而用缓存词元解码（cached-token decoding），在全部 450 次测试解码里都能复现未拆分模型的输出。

articles.title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
articles.zh: MindView：生成式多视角空间智能基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你想评估多模态模型到底懂不懂三维空间，这个 benchmark 专考多视角一致性，别被单图成绩忽悠
articles.author: Yanbo Wang, Siqi Luo 等
articles.body: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view observations remains underexplored. We introduce MindView, a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence with 1,500 samples from 513 scenes across three indoor datasets. Its seven tasks form two families: geometry-dominant tasks specify changes in camera position and orientation, while semantics-dominant tasks require inferring target viewpoints by grounding referred objects and interpreting spatial relations and reference-frame cues. Evaluation of eleven generators reveals substantial room for improvement on MindView. A paired context analysis further shows that all eleven generators obtain lower overall scores under the expanded context setting. These findings motivate us to investigate whether task-specific supervision can improve target-view generation and whether models can use additional multi-view evidence effectively. We therefore fine-tune BAGEL on the MindView training dataset, improving its overall score by 24.3 points and yielding gains across all seven MindView tasks. Beyond these generation gains, the fine-tuned model also yields higher scores on three spatial-understanding benchmarks without training on their annotations, suggesting that learning to generate spatially grounded views may benefit spatial understanding. To improve evidence utilization under expanded context, we propose MindCue, a training-free spatial evidence selector guided by a target-view hypothesis. MindCue reverses the drop in overall score under expanded context and outperforms the standard-context baseline. Overall, MindView provides a concrete testbed for generative multi-view spatial intelligence.
articles.bodyZh: 空间智能（Spatial intelligence）最近开始通过生成任务来评估，比如基于空间定位的图像编辑（spatially grounded image editing）。不过，从部分多视角观测出发，用语言引导生成空间一致的视角，这块研究还远远不够。我们推出了 MindView，这是一个面向生成式多视角空间智能的基准（benchmark），包含来自三个室内数据集的 513 个场景、共 1500 个样本。它的七项任务分成两大类：几何主导型任务（geometry-dominant tasks）会明确指定相机位置和朝向的变化；语义主导型任务（semantics-dominant tasks）则要求模型先对被指代物体做定位（grounding），再理解空间关系和参考系线索（reference-frame cues），从而推断目标视角。我们评测了 11 个生成器，发现它们在 MindView 上还有很大提升空间。配对上下文分析（paired context analysis）进一步显示，在扩展上下文设置（expanded context setting）下，这 11 个生成器的总体得分全都更低。这些发现促使我们去研究：任务特定监督（task-specific supervision）能不能提升目标视角生成，以及模型能不能有效利用额外的多视角证据。于是我们在 MindView 训练集上微调（fine-tune）BAGEL，让它的总体得分提高了 24.3 分，并且在 MindView 七项任务上都有提升。除了生成上的提升，这个微调后的模型在三个空间理解基准（spatial-understanding benchmarks）上也拿到了更高分，而且没有用这些基准的标注（annotations）训练过；这说明学习生成具有空间定位的视角，可能也会帮助空间理解。为了在扩展上下文下更好地利用证据，我们提出了 MindCue——一个无需训练（training-free）的空间证据选择器（spatial evidence selector），由目标视角假设（target-view hypothesis）来引导。MindCue 把扩展上下文下总体得分下降的趋势扭转了回来，而且超过了标准上下文基线（standard-context baseline）。总的来说，MindView 为生成式多视角空间智能（generative multi-view spatial intelligence）提供了一个具体的测试平台（testbed）。

articles.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
articles.zh: 自适应多 Token 预测：我们该走多远？
articles.summary: 如果你在训 LLM 想靠 multi-token prediction 提速，这篇帮你判断预测头开到几个 token 才真的划算
articles.author: Emile Anand, Mohammed Rehan Parwani 等
articles.body: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with context: longer drafts offer greater amortization when reliable, but can waste compute on suffixes discarded after a rejection. Unlike autoregressive drafting, where a stopping rule can decide token by token, MTP must fix the horizon before drafting, as all heads fire in the same forward pass. We therefore formulate horizon selection as an online control problem, using verification feedback to learn how far the draft can be trusted in each context, and introduce Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction (AMTP): a lightweight controller that requires no retraining and leaves the exact verifier unchanged. To guide horizon selection, we characterize the expected number of tokens committed at each horizon via acceptance survival, the probability that a draft prefix is fully accepted. Before each round, AMTP predicts how far the draft is likely to survive and picks the horizon with the highest expected tokens per second, learning freely from every verification pass. Theoretically, we show that any online learner's prediction error translates into throughput regret against the best horizon for each context, and in turn into a bound on wall-clock completion time. With online gradient descent, this regret is sublinear. Across five draft-target pairings built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with Medusa heads, Meta's MTP models, and Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP, evaluated on AIME 2025 and GSM8K, AMTP decodes up to 4.1x faster than standard decoding and matches or outperforms the fixed window in 8 of 10 settings, with throughput gains of up to 10%.
articles.bodyZh: 多 token 预测（Multi-token prediction, MTP）能加速语言模型解码（decoding）：先一口气起草（drafting）好几个 token 的草稿，再让目标模型一次前向（target-model pass）把它们全验证掉。但最佳投机视野（speculation horizon）不是固定的，得看上下文（context）：草稿拉长时，只要靠谱，就能把一次验证的开销摊得更薄；可一旦前面某个 token 被拒，后面那串草稿就全废了，算力也白花。自回归起草（autoregressive drafting）可以靠停止规则（stopping rule）一个 token 一个 token 地决定啥时候停，但 MTP 不行，它得在起草前就把视野定死，因为所有预测头（heads）是在同一次前向（forward pass）里一起出结果的。所以，我们把“选多长的视野”建模成一个在线控制问题（online control problem）：用验证反馈（verification feedback）来学，在每个上下文里草稿到底能信多远，并提出了自适应多 token 预测（Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction, AMTP）：它是个轻量控制器（controller），不用重新训练（retraining），也完全不改原来的精确验证器（verifier）。为了指导视野选择，我们用一个叫接受存活（acceptance survival）的量来刻画每个视野下平均能最终采纳（committed）多少 token——说白了，就是一段草稿前缀（draft prefix）能被完整接受的概率。每一轮开始前，AMTP 先预测这轮草稿大概能活到多长，然后挑“每秒期望产出 token 数（expected tokens per second）”最高的那个视野；而且每次验证都能拿来免费学习，不用额外标注。理论上我们证明了：任何在线学习器（online learner）的预测误差（prediction error），都会变成相对于每个上下文最佳视野的吞吐量损失（throughput regret），进而给出实际完成时间（wall-clock completion time）的上界。用在线梯度下降（online gradient descent）时，这个损失是次线性（sublinear）的，也就是随着轮数增加，平均损失会越来越小。我们在五组草稿-目标模型组合（draft-target pairings）上做了评测：基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 搭配 Medusa 预测头（Medusa heads）、Meta 的 MTP 模型，以及 Qwen3-4B-Inst-2507-MTP，测试集是 AIME 2025 和 GSM8K。结果显示，AMTP 的解码速度最高能达到标准解码（standard decoding）的 4.1 倍；在 10 个设置里有 8 个追平或超过固定窗口（fixed window），吞吐量最多提升 10%。

articles.title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
articles.zh: NarraSpace：基于多模态场景证据的看图描述痴呆症分类
articles.summary: 如果你做医疗 AI 或多模态评估，这篇把"看图说话"的表述和场景证据对齐，用来做认知障碍筛查
articles.author: Qingming Li, Ruiyan Sun 等
articles.body: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves $80.88\%\pm2.56\%$ mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield $81.25\%$ accuracy and $91.32\%$ area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.
articles.bodyZh: 看图描述做痴呆症分类（picture-description dementia classification）时，大家用的是同一张视觉场景（shared visual scene），但光靠转写文本层面的预测（transcript-level prediction），没法看出这个预测到底依赖了图里的哪些证据。NarraSpace 会把词和说话时间对应到图中命名的画面元素上，并针对预设的场景事件找出相应的话语。叙事-空间描述符（Narrative-spatial descriptors）则概括覆盖范围和时间组织。一个冻结的语言模型（frozen language model）会拿阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease）和健康对照（healthy-control）训练参与者的样例来对比每个事件的文本，同时结合转写文本的意外度（transcript surprisal）和覆盖度测量（coverage measurements）。保留下来的源记录会把事件得分连回原话语、语音区间和词汇匹配。在阿尔茨海默病自发语音识别基准（Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark）官方48人测试集上，一个固定的支持向量分类器（support vector classifier）在50个随机种子（seeds）上平均准确率达到80.88%±2.56%；把概率平均后，准确率为81.25%，ROC曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve）为91.32%。NarraSpace 把按事件索引的语言模型测量结果，连到它们对应的话语、说话时间和抽取记录上，让和场景挂钩的分类输入是怎么构造出来的变得明明白白、可以检查。这种能追到源头的测量结果（source-linked measurements），可以在临床医生复核（clinician review）图片描述时帮上忙：把量化摘要和原始语音证据放在一起看。

articles.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
articles.zh: 面向自主系统诊断的语义可观测性
articles.summary: 如果你在 debug 自动驾驶或机器人系统，光看日志和指标不够，这篇讲怎么让系统内部状态在语义层面真正"可见"
articles.author: Jitendra Solanki, Anand Todkar 等
articles.body: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes during cascading failures remains an arduous task for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), bottlenecked by manual keyword filtering and disjointed temporal correlation across monitoring dashboards. We introduce Semantic Observability, an autonomous multi-agent framework that unifies disparate log streams into a dynamic, queryable Property Graph Database. By modeling physical infrastructure topologies, logical software dependencies, and chronological event sequences as attributed nodes and directed relations, it bridges the semantic gap inherent in flat, unstructured log repositories. Building on this unified substrate, we deploy a stateful multi-agent system orchestrated through Directed Cyclic Graphs (DCGs). The system autonomously navigates the topology, applying causal graph algorithms and temporal back-traversal to isolate the precise blast radius of anomalies. The pruned subgraph is then interpreted by a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning engine to generate contextualized, code-level Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and actionable remediations. This paper establishes the foundational system architecture, formal relational ontology, and multi-agent control loops of Semantic Observability. We show conceptually how the framework eliminates ambient telemetry noise, reduces Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), compresses LLM token consumption, and prevents structural hallucinations. We also specify an open-source validation framework on standard benchmarks (LogHub and Train-Ticket), laying the groundwork for a forthcoming companion paper on exhaustive quantitative evaluation and production benchmarking.
articles.bodyZh: 现代分布式微服务部署，会在物理和逻辑上分区的基础设施里，产生海量、五花八门、格式各异的可观测性日志。一旦发生级联故障，站点可靠性工程师（Site Reliability Engineers, SREs）想定位根因仍然非常费劲，主要卡在手动关键词过滤，以及监控看板之间割裂的时间关联上。我们提出“语义可观测性”（Semantic Observability），这是一个自主多智能体框架，能把分散的日志流统一进一个动态、可查询的属性图数据库（Property Graph Database）。它把物理基础设施拓扑、逻辑软件依赖关系和时间顺序事件，建模成带属性的节点和有向关系，从而补上扁平、非结构化日志仓库里天然存在的语义鸿沟。基于这个统一底座，我们部署了一套有状态的多智能体系统，用有向循环图（Directed Cyclic Graphs, DCGs）来编排。系统会自主在拓扑中导航，运用因果图算法和时间回溯，精确圈出异常的影响范围（blast radius）。剪枝后的子图再交给大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）推理引擎解读，生成结合上下文的代码级根因分析（Root Cause Analyses, RCA）和可执行的修复建议。本文确立了语义可观测性的基础系统架构、形式化关系本体和多智能体控制回路。我们从概念上说明，这个框架如何消除环境遥测噪声、降低平均解决时间（Mean Time to Resolution, MTTR）、压缩 LLM token 消耗，并防止结构性幻觉。我们还说明了基于标准基准（LogHub 和 Train-Ticket）的开源验证框架，为后续配套论文中详尽的定量评估和生产基准测试打下基础。
